one_month_reasoning: Q3 2026 results most likely land in early November, just after 2026-10-29 (date unconfirmed). In-window industry events: PJM's Reliability Backstop Procurement bid window runs Sep 30 to Oct 21, 2026 (corrected from 'through November'), with selection and results between Oct 22 and Dec 2, so no clearing result falls in the window; FERC/PJM co-location follow-through; positioning ahead of the December 2026 2029/30 BRA, already collared at ~$325/MW-day. None is a binary event for CEG. No Calpine-share unlock falls in the window (the next ~25M-share tranche unlocks 2027-06-30), though already-free shares (~13M) can still be sold. Drifts roughly offset: mild reversal after the 13% Sep 9-18 slide and the buyback bid vs. rising yields (10y 5.24% after the Sep 17 Fed hike) and possible holder selling. Net: near-symmetric lognormal centred ~$265.5 at ~13.5% monthly sigma (47%/3.5), a touch lower at the top than round 1 because of the rate backdrop.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (framework 2028E total EPS ~$14.2 x 19.5x = $277, 80%) and a haircut consensus analyst target ($347 x 0.77 = $267, 20%) gives ~$275 12 months out.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: 2028E total adjusted EPS $14.2 (guided base EPS + enhanced) x 19.5x forward P/E

inputs_detail.derivation: Per Q2 2026 deck slide 14 and March 2026 outlook slides 6/22 (supervisor-verified); round 1 wrongly cited the post-2029 10%+ target as the near-term path.

Framework implies $11.8-12.8 (base $7.60-7.70 at 60-65% of total) at end-2025 forwards; I take the upper part given the $0.50 raise to the 2026 guide and firm PJM West forwards (~$84-85/MWh), below the $13.34 consensus.

Interpolated base EPS (~$9.4) plus enhanced earnings at ~33-35% of total gives ~$14.0-14.5; capacity revenue locked at ~$325-333/MW-day through May 2029 (18.9 GW cleared) and Crane restart in 2027 support it.

CEG trades ~20x 2027E-ish today; peers VST/TLN de-rated in 2026. I take 0.5 turn off round-1's 20x because the 10y is now 5.24% (up ~77bp since June, Fed hiked Sep 17) and ~25M Calpine-consideration shares unlock inside the horizon (2027-06-30).

Targets rest on 2027 consensus EPS ($13.34) that already sits above management's own framework (~$11.8-12.8), so a February 2027 guide reset is a real risk; haircut raised from 20% and weight cut from 30% to 20%.

bear.story: Feb 2027 guide resets 2027 EPS toward the framework's ~$12 vs $13.34 consensus, the ~25M-share Calpine unlock on 2027-06-30 hits a soft tape, 10y stays >5%, RBP and connect-and-manage add new-build supply expectations, political pressure keeps PJM capacity collared after 2029/30, ERCOT stays soft and AI-load forecasts get cut. ~$12.5-13 EPS on ~14.5x.

base.story: Earnings track the management framework (2028E ~$14.2) on capped-but-high PJM capacity revenue, Crane restart in 2027, a few more nuclear PPAs and buybacks ($2.8B left) absorbing much of the unlocked supply; multiple ~19.5x with rates elevated.

bull.story: One or more GW-scale hyperscaler/co-location nuclear deals at premium prices, PJM scarcity (6.8 GW shortfall, uncapped $555/MW-day) lifts forward energy and contract prices, enhanced earnings beat the framework, rates ease, and the multiple re-rates to ~25x on 2028E ~$15.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$195 (about 14x the framework 2028E of ~$14.2 and ~15% under the 52-week low of $228.63) the stock would be pricing a lasting cut to earnings rather than supply/rate noise: e.g. a regulatory change that caps or claws back PJM capacity or energy revenue beyond the current collar, loss/restructuring of a flagship nuclear PPA, a major nuclear operating problem, or a sharp reset of PJM data-center load forecasts. Unlock- and rate-driven dips toward $210-220 are plausible without a thesis break.

Whether data-center load materializes as fast as PJM forecasts or hyperscalers slow capex

reasoning: Industry lane, round 2. The value-chain picture is unchanged: PJM capacity is locked at the ~$325/MW-day cap through May 2029 (CEG cleared ~18.9 GW), PJM West forwards are firm, a 6.8 GW shortfall is being addressed by the RBP (bids Sep 30-Oct 21, results Dec 2, then the December 2029/30 BRA under the collar), peers VST/TLN/NRG de-rated despite record results, and contracting is slower than the AI narrative. Supervisor corrections I accept: (1) management's 20%+ CAGR applies to base EPS 2026-29, with 10%+ only after 2029; enhanced earnings are 30-40% of total, so total EPS runs ~$12 / ~$12-13 / ~$14.2 for 2026-28 and 2027 consensus ($13.34) sits above the framework, adding guide-reset risk in Feb 2027; (2) ~38M Calpine-consideration shares remain with former holders, ~25M locked until 2027-06-30 (my 5.9% figure was unsourced), confirmed by the lock-up terms (half released 2026-06-30, half 2027-06-30); (3) the 10y is 5.24% after a Sep 17 hike. My 2028E ($14.2) barely moves, but I trim the multiple to 19.5x, raise the target haircut and cut its weight, giving fair value ~$275 (from $284), ~4% above spot. Scenarios $185/$278/$375 at 25/50/25 (mean ~$279). Ladder: lognormal, median ~$268, sigma ~0.41 (below 47% realized because part of it was a one-off overhang, but wider than round 1 for the unlock and rates), with slightly fattened tails; P(>=spot) 0.515 vs 0.535 in round 1. Research this round limited to 3 searches; no options or IV consulted.
